ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: checkout-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 07:42 UTC)
Alerting service: checkout
Alert time: 2026-04-07T07:42:00Z
Data available from 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T09:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 2 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-07T09:00:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-04-07T06:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check error rate metric for checkout service to confirm anomaly.)
  Result: M-014: Change detected at 2026-04-07T06:15:00Z: mean 0.52 before, 14.6 after (373.6 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-014] checkout.error_rate_pct from 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.18 max=29.99 mean=13.43 last=29.66; mean=13.43. Change detected at 2026-04-07T06:15:00Z: mean 0.52 before, 14.6 after (373.6 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-04-07T06:15:00Z = 0.18 (first point after the change); 2026-04-07T06:15:00Z = 0.18 (lowest); 2026-04-07T08:00:00Z = 29.99 (peak); 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z = 29.66 (last).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-07T09:00:00Z", "metric": "db_pool_in_use_pct", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-04-07T06:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if the database connection pool is exhausted for checkout.)
  Result: M-012: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-012] checkout.db_pool_in_use_pct from 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=24.49 max=36.53 mean=29.46 last=26.21; mean=29.46. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-04-07T08:00:00Z = 24.49 (lowest); 2026-04-07T08:40:00Z = 36.53 (peak); 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z = 26.21 (last).
Step 3: metrics_query {"end": "2026-04-07T09:00:00Z", "metric": "restarts", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-04-07T06:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check if checkout service has been restarting or crashing (could indicate OOM).)
  Result: M-018: Change detected at 2026-04-07T07:40:00Z: mean 0 before, 0.5 after (500000.0 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-018] checkout.restarts from 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z (36 points, 5-minute steps): min=0 max=3 mean=0.22 last=0; mean=0.22. Change detected at 2026-04-07T07:40:00Z: mean 0 before, 0.5 after (500000.0 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z = 0 (lowest); 2026-04-07T07:40:00Z = 3 (first point after the change); 2026-04-07T07:40:00Z = 3 (peak); 2026-04-07T08:55:00Z = 0 (last).
Step 4: log_search {"end": "2026-04-07T06:30:00Z", "limit": 30, "query": "deploy version start", "service": "checkout", "start": "2026-04-07T06:00:00Z"} (asked because: Search for deployment or startup logs around 06:15 UTC when the error rate jumped.)
  Result: 0 matching log lines.

Previous hypotheses:
- bad_deployment: The error rate jumped abruptly at 06:15 UTC, which often correlates with a newly deployed version containing a defect. (evidence: M-014)
- downstream_timeout: The checkout service relies on external dependencies and payments which could be timing out and raising the error rate. (evidence: M-014)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: Sudden increases in HTTP error rates can be caused by database connection pool exhaustion during traffic or operational shifts. (evidence: M-014)
